Overview

Saham is a city in Al Batinah with a population of 90,000. A coastal city in the Al Batinah region, known for its fishing port, the Saham Fort, and its long sandy beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
